title: Apply for a Companion Card
summary: Find out if you are eligible for and how to apply for a NSW Companion Card, which allows a support person free entry to participating venues and events.
intro: The NSW Companion Card program is for people with significant and permanent disabilities who have a lifelong need for attendant care support when accessing the community. The Companion Card allows a cardholder’s support person free entry into participating venues and events.
who_can_apply: Be a person with significant and permanent disability.
Be unable to participate in most community activities without attendant care support due to the impact of your disability.
Require life-long attendant care at this level.
Be an Australian citizen or permanent resident and live in NSW.

how_to_steps.text: Visit Get a Companion Card to check what you'll need to apply, then select 'Apply now'.
Prepare all of your supporting documentation.
Complete the online application with your supporting documents.

contact: Learn more about the Companion Card.

external_links.text: Am I eligible for a Companion Card?

faqs.q: What is the NSW Companion Card for?
faqs.a: The Companion Card program is for people with significant and permanent disabilities who need lifelong attendant care support when accessing the community. It allows a cardholder’s support person free entry into participating venues and events.

faqs.q: Does having an NDIS plan mean I qualify for the Companion Card?
faqs.a: No. Eligibility for the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) does not mean you meet the NSW Companion Card criteria.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a Companion Card?
faqs.a: Visit Get a Companion Card to check what you'll need to apply, then select 'Apply now'. You must also prepare all supporting documentation and complete the online application.
